ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity dark field across the entire fluke. Stochastic distribution of high-intensity white point-clusters (mottling) throughout the mid-sections of both lobes. Increased density of high-intensity pixels at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, creating a jagged silhouette against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the superior outer edges of both lobes, transitioning into a linear inward sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) distributed stochastically across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of fine, high-contrast vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, consistent with rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular mass and loss of standard geometric contour at the distal tip of the left lobe, characterized by high-contrast white and reddish-brown pixels.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct reddish-brown pigmentation/encrustation localized at the extreme lateral point of the left fluke tip.
